answer_1.quote: We present Contrastive Novelty-Augmented Learning (CoNAL), a method to improve the OSSC ability of a classifier by automatically generating OOD examples, then training to abstain on them.
answer_1.outputs: novel class examples and labels for open-set selective classification

answer_4.quote: we manually inspect the generated labels and examples from our method... we manually annotate GPT-3 generated labels... we manually annotate GPT-J generated examples
answer_4.guideline: categorizing a label into 'implausible' if it does conform to the dataset's format, 'closed-set' (ID) if it is synonymous with a class seen in training, and 'novel' (OOD) if it describes a class distinct from all closed-set classes
